definition.zh: 蒙台梭利敏感期：某个阶段孩子对秩序、语言、细节、社交等特别投入的一般知识。
definition.en: Montessori sensitive periods: general knowledge about stages when a child is especially drawn to order, language, detail, social play and similar.

zh: 孩子特别执着于物品摆放是敏感期吗
en: Which sensitive period is my child in?
What should I know about sensitive periods?

definition.zh: 睡眠：夜间睡眠时长、入睡与起床时间、午睡、作息规律、夜醒。
definition.en: Sleep: night sleep duration, bedtime and wake time, naps, routine regularity, night waking.

zh: 写作业太晚会影响睡眠吗
en: Is my child sleeping enough lately?
Is the bedtime routine regular?
How are the naps going?

definition.zh: 性教育与身体边界：身体隐私、界限、与孩子谈论身体和青春期话题的方式。
definition.en: Sexuality education and body boundaries: body privacy, boundaries, and how to talk with a child about bodies and puberty topics.

zh: 怎么跟孩子讲身体隐私
性教育从什么时候开始
孩子问宝宝从哪来怎么回答
en: How do I explain body privacy?
When should sex education start?

definition.zh: 数字使用：看屏幕、手机、平板、电脑、游戏、短视频等电子设备使用的时长和习惯。
definition.en: Digital use: time and habits around screens, phones, tablets, computers, games and short videos.

zh: 孩子玩手机的时间多吗
打游戏停不下来怎么办
en: How much screen time is okay?
How should we handle phone use?
My child can't stop gaming

definition.zh: 疫苗接种：已接种的疫苗、接种日期和接种记录。
definition.en: Vaccination: vaccines received, vaccination dates and vaccination records.

zh: 上一针是什么时候打的
en: Which vaccines has my child had?
When was the last shot?

definition.zh: 体检与儿保：常规体检、儿保检查及其中记录的测量和检查项目。
definition.en: Checkups: routine health checkups and well-child visits and the measurements recorded there.

en: What did the last checkup record?
Which well-child checks were done?

definition.zh: 生长：身高、体重、头围、BMI 的测量记录和变化。
definition.en: Growth: height, weight, head circumference and BMI records and their changes.

en: How is height developing?
Has my child grown since last time?

definition.zh: 视力：左右眼视力、眼轴、眼压等眼部检查记录，以及近视相关的问题。
definition.en: Vision: left and right visual acuity, axial length, eye pressure and other eye exam records, and myopia-related questions.

en: How is my child's eyesight lately?
Has the axial length changed?

definition.zh: 户外活动：户外时长记录、家长设定的每周户外目标、晒太阳和户外运动的习惯。
definition.en: Outdoor time: recorded outdoor minutes, the parent's weekly outdoor goal, and habits of daylight and outdoor play.

en: Is my child getting enough outdoor time?
How much outdoor time this week?

definition.zh: 发育里程碑：大运动、精细动作、语言、社交等里程碑的达成记录。
definition.en: Developmental milestones: recorded achievements in gross motor, fine motor, language, social and similar areas.

zh: 最近达成了哪些里程碑
语言方面有什么新进展
en: Which milestones were reached recently?
Any new language progress?

definition.zh: 营养与饮食：辅食、吃饭、挑食、饮食习惯。
definition.en: Nutrition and eating: solid foods, meals, picky eating and eating habits.

en: What about picky eating?
How should solids be introduced?

definition.zh: 口腔：换牙、出牙、龋齿、洗牙、牙科就诊和矫正相关记录。
definition.en: Dental: tooth eruption and loss, cavities, cleanings, dental visits and orthodontic records.

en: Show me the dental records
How is tooth replacement going?

definition.zh: 日常观察：随记里记录的情绪、专注、社交互动、兴趣和行为。
definition.en: Everyday observation: moods, focus, social interaction, interests and behaviour written in journal entries.

zh: 孩子一直喜欢画画，要不要开始系统学
en: What did the recent journal entries say?
How has my child's mood been?
My child has loved drawing for years; should we start formal lessons?
